spec.hypothesis: cash-converting nonfinancial issuers allocating a higher fraction of positive FCF to gross common repurchases may outperform SPY
spec.eligibility: current admitted annual filing; buybacks/OCF/capex reported for identical annual start/end/accession; OCF>0; FCF=OCF-capex>0; 0<buybacks<=FCF; exclude SIC H

normalization.repurchase_fraction: gross common repurchases / positive matched FCF

spec.interpretation: cash allocation ratios, not valuation yields, net payout, net share retirement or proof of debt-free funding
spec.identity: one security per dated CIK; alphabetical ticker before eligibility, score or return; no replacement if its return is missing
spec.score: equal mean of two higher-is-better percentiles on eligible unique issuers

costs.funding: each slot funds purchase plus both commissions; exit commission reserved in cash
costs.round_trip: every independent period; SPY has one funded position

spec.calendar: 57 frozen independent holding periods, exact same sessions as parent SPY; no continuous CAGR

bootstrap.resampling: joint circular full-calendar blocks across both costs
bootstrap.missing: any missing quarter prevents bound; never compress calendar

multiplicity.decision_guard: Bonferroni over known lower bound of 34 configurations; incomplete prior ledger, no global error-control claim

spec.daily_gate: positive IC with p<alpha; >=30 eligible issuers on >=30 dates and >=8 per window; positive mean SPY excess in every window; positive lower bound for both costs, >=30 valid periods and >=8 per window
spec.secondary_control: funded equal-weight all eligible unique issuers, same costs; descriptive only, no additional candidate or hypothesis test
spec.preservation: frozen originals, operational DB, Investor, #43/#44 and #53 untouched
